title: Types Of Taxes
definition: Taxes are compulsory unrequited payments made by individuals and corporations to the government to finance public goods and services. They are broadly classified based on incidence (Direct vs Indirect), economic impact (Progressive, Regressive, Proportional), and constitutional assignment.
importanceInUpsc: Fundamental pillar of Indian Economy (GS Paper III - Indian Economy and issues relating to mobilization of resources). Frequently tested in Prelims regarding the incidence of indirect taxes, GST mechanisms, progressive vs regressive taxation, and constitutional distribution of taxing powers under Schedule VII.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Types Of Taxes.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of fiscal policy, government budget, and federal financial relations.
